scope_decision.selection_reason: 综述/背景论证集中在引言与 Background 两节：引言回顾循环、卷积与注意力路线，Background 交代卷积序列模型、self-attention 既有应用与 memory networks，并给出与 [17, 18, 9] 的对比定位。两节均无子章节，范围连续覆盖其全部正文。

summary: 原文在引言与背景两节中按“既有主流 → 局部缓解 → 直接对照 → 自注意力先例”的顺序组织引用。先以 LSTM [13]、门控循环网络 [7]、RNN encoder–decoder [5]、seq2seq [35] 与注意力式 NMT [24] 确立循环序列模型在序列建模与机器翻译中的既有地位，再指出其沿符号位置分解计算带来的顺序约束无法通过因子分解技巧 [21] 或条件计算 [32] 根本解除。随后引用注意力式 NMT [24] 与结构化注意力网络 [19] 说明注意力已成为主流组件，却几乎总是与循环网络搭配使用，只有可分解注意力模型 [27] 等少数例外；再以端到端记忆网络 [34]、神经 GPU [17] 承认以注意力替代序列对齐递归的先例及其“仍是循环注意力、任务简单”的局限；最后以 ConvS2S [9]、ByteNet [18] 提供位置距离开销可量化的并行化对照，并以自注意力在阅读理解、摘要、文本蕴含与句表示上的既有应用支撑其作为通用序列建模组件的可行性，从而为提出完全依赖 self-attention 的 Transformer 划出清晰边界。

early.summary: 早期引用集中奠定了循环序列建模的骨架：LSTM [13] 与门控循环网络评测 [7] 确立了长序列建模的 state of the art，RNN encoder–decoder [5] 与 seq2seq [35] 把循环网络推入机器翻译的主流，注意力式 NMT [24] 给出了注意力融入该体系的代表方案，而梯度流分析 [12] 则提供了远距离依赖难以学习的经典依据。

mid.summary: 中期引用把讨论从循环架构扩展到注意力本身：端到端记忆网络 [34] 与神经 GPU [17] 用循环注意力替代序列对齐递归，构成最接近的先例；可分解注意力模型 [27] 则是论文自己点名的少数不依赖循环的例外；自注意力在阅读理解 [4]、语言建模上限 [15]、任务无关句子表示 [22] 与注意力式 NMT [24] 上的成功，说明注意力已成为可独立承担序列建模的通用组件。

recent.summary: 近期引用与本文方法直接相邻：ConvS2S [9] 与 ByteNet [18] 代表卷积并行化路线，其位置距离开销随距离增长、难以学习远距离依赖；因子分解技巧 [21] 与稀疏门控混合专家层 [32] 说明既有缓解手段只做局部改良、无法解除顺序计算约束；结构化注意力网络 [19]、强化学习摘要 [28] 与结构化句表示 [22] 则显示自注意力在生成式与表示式任务上已可独立工作。

mentions.snippet: Recurrent neural networks, long short-term memory [13] and gated recurrent [7] neural networks in particular, have been firmly established as state of the art approaches in sequence modeling and transduction problems such as language modeling and machine translation [35, 2, 5]. Numerous efforts have since continued to push the boundaries of recurrent language models and encoder-decoder architectures [38, 24, 15].

Attention mechanisms have become an integral part of compelling sequence modeling and transduction models in various tasks, allowing modeling of dependencies without regard to their distance in the input or output sequences [2, 19]. In all but a few cases [27], however, such attention mechanisms are used in conjunction with a recurrent network.

author: Jonas Gehring
M. Auli
D. Grangier
D. Yarats
Y. Dauphin
reference.title: Convolutional Sequence to Sequence Learning

mentions.snippet: The goal of reducing sequential computation also forms the foundation of the Extended Neural GPU [16], ByteNet [18] and ConvS2S [9], all of which use convolutional neural networks as basic building block, computing hidden representations in parallel for all input and output positions. In these models, the number of operations required to relate signals from two arbitrary input or output positions grows in the distance between positions, linearly for ConvS2S and logarithmically for ByteNet. This makes it more difficult to learn dependencies between distant positions [12]. In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions, an effect we counteract with Multi-Head Attention as described in section 3.2.

To the best of our knowledge, however, the Transformer is the first transduction model relying entirely on self-attention to compute representations of its input and output without using sequencealigned RNNs or convolution. In the following sections, we will describe the Transformer, motivate self-attention and discuss its advantages over models such as [17, 18] and [9].

items.summary: 论文借该文说明减少顺序计算在卷积路线上的实现方式是用 CNN 一次性算出所有位置的隐藏表示，但关联两个任意位置所需的操作数会随距离增长（ConvS2S 线性、ByteNet 对数），因而难以学习远距离依赖；Transformer 用自注意力把该操作数降为常数。两处提及都把该文放在与自注意力路线对立的卷积模型一侧。

author: N. Kalchbrenner
L. Espeholt
K. Simonyan
A. van den Oord
Alex Graves
K. Kavukcuoglu
reference.title: Neural Machine Translation in Linear Time

mentions.snippet: The goal of reducing sequential computation also forms the foundation of the Extended Neural GPU [16], ByteNet [18] and ConvS2S [9], all of which use convolutional neural networks as basic building block, computing hidden representations in parallel for all input and output positions. In these models, the number of operations required to relate signals from two arbitrary input or output positions grows in the distance between positions, linearly for ConvS2S and logarithmically for ByteNet. This makes it more difficult to learn dependencies between distant positions [12]. In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions, an effect we counteract with Multi-Head Attention as described in section 3.2.

To the best of our knowledge, however, the Transformer is the first transduction model relying entirely on self-attention to compute representations of its input and output without using sequencealigned RNNs or convolution. In the following sections, we will describe the Transformer, motivate self-attention and discuss its advantages over models such as [17, 18] and [9].

reference.title: Factorization tricks for LSTM networks

mentions.snippet: Recurrent models typically factor computation along the symbol positions of the input and output sequences. Aligning the positions to steps in computation time, they generate a sequence of hidden states $h _ { t } ,$ as a function of the previous hidden state $h _ { t - 1 }$ and the input for position t. This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths, as memory constraints limit batching across examples. Recent work has achieved significant improvements in computational efficiency through factorization tricks [21] and conditional computation [32], while also improving model performance in case of the latter. The fundamental constraint of sequential computation, however, remains.

report_md:
## 文献综述章节引文线索

### 总体总结
原文在引言与背景两节中按“既有主流 → 局部缓解 → 直接对照 → 自注意力先例”的顺序组织引用。先以 LSTM [13]、门控循环网络 [7]、RNN encoder–decoder [5]、seq2seq [35] 与注意力式 NMT [24] 确立循环序列模型在序列建模与机器翻译中的既有地位，再指出其沿符号位置分解计算带来的顺序约束无法通过因子分解技巧 [21] 或条件计算 [32] 根本解除。随后引用注意力式 NMT [24] 与结构化注意力网络 [19] 说明注意力已成为主流组件，却几乎总是与循环网络搭配使用，只有可分解注意力模型 [27] 等少数例外；再以端到端记忆网络 [34]、神经 GPU [17] 承认以注意力替代序列对齐递归的先例及其“仍是循环注意力、任务简单”的局限；最后以 ConvS2S [9]、ByteNet [18] 提供位置距离开销可量化的并行化对照，并以自注意力在阅读理解、摘要、文本蕴含与句表示上的既有应用支撑其作为通用序列建模组件的可行性，从而为提出完全依赖 self-attention 的 Transformer 划出清晰边界。


### 关键文献

- [9] Jonas Gehring, 2017: Convolutional Sequence to Sequence Learning (Baseline)

- [13] S. Hochreiter, 1997: Long Short-Term Memory (Background)

- [17] Łukasz Kaiser, 2016: Neural GPUs learn algorithms (Baseline)

- [18] N. Kalchbrenner, 2017: Neural Machine Translation in Linear Time (Baseline)

- [27] Ankur Parikh, 2016: A decomposable attention model (Contrast)



### 范围
- 章节: 1 Introduction + 2 Background
- 行号: 25-43

### 按功能归类


#### Uncategorized

- [2] D. Bahdanau, 2014
  - 标题: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate
  - 关键词: attention, seq2seq, NMT, encoder-decoder, soft alignment
  - 总结: 在本节语境中，该引用承担双重论证职能：一方面它为“注意力机制已成为 compelling sequence modeling 与 transduction 模型不可分割的组成部分”提供原始出处，界定了本文所推进的注意力技术谱系；另一方面它也是“注意力几乎都与循环网络联合使用”这一论断的典型样本，源文借此把当时的主流范式概括为 RNN + attention 的组合，从而为“Transformer 是第一个完全依赖 self-attention、既不用序列对齐的 RNN 也不用卷积的 transduction 模型”这一新颖性主张划出清晰的边界。源文并未在该处引用其具体对齐算法或实验结果，仅将其作为范式层面的支点。



#### Component

- [4] Jian-Peng Cheng, 2016
  - 标题: Long Short-Term Memory-Networks for Machine Reading
  - 关键词: self-attention, reading comprehension, LSTM, sentence representation
  - 总结: 在本节语境中，该引用只是 self-attention 任务覆盖面清单中的一个实例：它说明“把注意力用于序列内部不同位置之间的关联”这一做法，已被用于机器阅读这类需要跨位置推理的任务，从而佐证 self-attention 并非 Transformer 才引入的新机制。源文在此不涉及其具体网络结构或注意力层的实现细节，其功能是历史与覆盖面意义上的背景铺垫，而不是对比或论证依据。



#### Baseline

- [5] Kyunghyun Cho, 2014
  - 标题: Learning Phrase Representations using RNN Encoder–Decoder for Statistical Machine Translation
  - 关键词: seq2seq, encoder-decoder, RNN, phrase representation, SMT
  - 总结: 在本节语境中，该引用的作用是把“encoder-decoder 架构”与“循环网络”牢牢绑定为一个既有范式：它示范了以 RNN 编码输入句子、解码生成目标短语的端到端翻译框架，并证明该框架在机器翻译上取得强结果。源文以此支撑“RNN 已被 firmly established as state of the art”这一前提性判断，进而说明其沿时间步的顺序计算为何成为必须绕开的瓶颈；引用本身不承担对比或方法继承的功能，也不涉及其内部结构细节。

- [9] Jonas Gehring, 2017
  - 标题: Convolutional Sequence to Sequence Learning
  - 关键词: ConvS2S, CNN, seq2seq, parallel computation, contrast baseline
  - 总结: 在本节语境中，该引用是论文并行化论证中最具体、最可量化的对照物：源文借它指出卷积模型虽然以并行方式计算所有位置的隐藏表示，但关联任意两个输入/输出位置所需的操作数会随位置距离增长——对 ConvS2S 是线性增长（对 ByteNet 是对数增长），因而更难学习远距离依赖；而 Transformer 把该操作数降为常数，仅以注意力加权平均带来的有效分辨率下降为代价。源文还在结尾把它明确列入“将要讨论优势”的对照名单，使它成为全文比较框架中的正式基线。

- [16] Lukasz Kaiser, 2016
  - 标题: Can Active Memory Replace Attention?
  - 关键词: Extended Neural GPU, CNN, parallel computation, active memory, sequence modeling
  - 总结: 在本节语境中，该引用承担“减少顺序计算”这一动机链条上的路线起点：它与 ByteNet、ConvS2S 一同说明，把循环计算替换为可并行的卷积操作是当时已被充分探索的替代思路，因而 Transformer 的差异化只能落在“以 self-attention 而非卷积操作来关联位置”这一点上。该工作本身探讨的是以主动记忆操作替代注意力计算，与源文关注点相邻但方向不同，源文在此仅借用其卷积化并行这一属性作为对照坐标，不涉及其内部机制或实验结论。

- [17] Łukasz Kaiser, 2016
  - 标题: Neural GPUs learn algorithms
  - 关键词: Neural GPU, algorithm learning, contrast baseline, convolution
  - 总结: 在本节语境中，该引用只以点名方式出现，功能是为源文的新颖性主张划定对照谱系：论文宣称 Transformer 是首个完全依赖 self-attention 计算输入与输出表示、且不使用序列对齐 RNN 或卷积的 transduction 模型，这一界线正是以 Neural GPU、ByteNet、ConvS2S 这一组既有模型为参照划出的；源文在此不展开其技术细节，仅把它列入后续章节将展开优势论证的对照名单，因此其角色是命名式对比基线而非论据来源。
